instruction: How to set up IPsec using EAP-MSCHAPv2 (username/password)
output:
<think>
The goal is to set up IPsec using EAP-MSCHAPv2 (username/password).
Here's how I'd approach this.
</think>
echo 'connections {
  eap-mschapv2 {
    version = 2
    local_addrs = 192.168.1.10
    remote_addrs = %any
    pools = vpn-pool
    local {
      auth = pubkey
      certs = server.crt
      id = server.example.com
    }
    remote {
      auth = eap-mschapv2
      eap_id = %any
    }
    children {
      net {
        local_ts = 0.0.0.0/0
      }
    }
  }
  pools {
    vpn-pool {
      addrs = 10.5.0.0/24
      dns = 8.8.8.8
    }
  }
}' > /etc/swanctl/swanctl.conf
